senses.gloss:
आध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Sounded, sounding.
 2. Inflated.
 3. Burnt.
 m.
(-तः)
 1. Flatulence, borborygmi, swelling of the abdomen with
noise.
 2. War, battle.
 E. आङ् before ध्मा to blow, affix क्त.

आध्मान n. (-नं)
 1. Blowing, inflation.
 2. A bellow.
 3. Intumescence,
[]
swelling of the belly, dropsy.
 E. आङ् before ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट
aff.
